from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """One university's data for quartile comparison based on Asian student proportion."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort, as a percentage")
    asian_non_hispanic_undergraduates: int | None = Field(description="Count of Asian, non-Hispanic undergraduates")
    total_undergraduates: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
